Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: Misidentification of Historical Context and Premature Task Completion

The error occurs in Step 13 when the Planner analyzes the successful retrieval of the Britannica page. While the visible text on the page explicitly states "Political Affiliation: Socialist Party of America" and describes Debs as a "Socialist Party candidate," the Planner incorrectly concludes that Debs was affiliated with the "Social Democratic Party of America (SDPA)." This is a hallucination or a confusion between the "Socialist Party of America" (SPA) and the "Social Democratic Party of America" (SDP), which were distinct entities in American history. The Planner then proceeds to mark the task as complete with the wrong party name ("Social Democratic Party of America") based on this incorrect interpretation of the source data, failing to verify the specific name of the party against the clear text provided in the search results.
